title: Scallion and Menemen Turkish Omelette
description: A flavorful and spicy Turkish-inspired omelette filled with scallions and menemen.

ingredients.name: Jubilant
ingredients.notes: Optional, chopped fresh herbs like parsley or dill

instructions: Crack 2 eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the pan and swirl it around.
Add the chopped scallions and menemen to the pan and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
Pour the whisked eggs over the scallions and menemen.
Sprinkle a pinch of Turkish paprika over the eggs.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the omelette towards the center.
Once the eggs are almost set, use the spatula to fold the omelette in half.
Cook for another minute and serve hot.
Optional: Garnish with chopped jubilant herbs.
